source.title: Andhra Pradesh High Court on Passport Denial Based on FIR
source.description:
Can your passport be denied just because an FIR has been filed against you?

The Andhra Pradesh High Court held that the answer is no.

The Court clarified that a mere FIR or pending police investigation is not enough to refuse a passport. Under the Passports Act, a passport can be denied only when criminal proceedings are pending before a competent court.

The judgment also reiterates that the right to travel abroad forms part of personal liberty under Article 21 of the Constitution.

pack.topic: Mere FIR or Police Complaint vs Court Stay in Property Registration
pack.source_script_insight: A mere complaint or FIR at the police stage does not legally bar rights (like passport issuance) unless formal court proceedings/cognizance take place under statutory law. Similarly, in property documentation, a mere police complaint or unadjudicated objection letter cannot automatically freeze property registration without a formal court injunction or competent authority order.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Coimbatore buyers often panic when a seller mentions a local police complaint or minor boundary FIR from neighbours, assuming registration is automatically blocked at the Sub-Registrar Office (SRO). Knowing that an active civil court injunction is required to legally halt registration prevents buyers from walking away from clean titles unnecessarily.
pack.core_takeaway: An unadjudicated police complaint or FIR alone does not legally bar property registration; verify whether a formal court injunction or stay order actually exists.

pack.title_english: Does an FIR Stop Property Registration in Coimbatore?
pack.caption_english: Does a police complaint or FIR automatically stop property registration in Coimbatore? Many buyers assume a police objection locks the title, but under Tamil Nadu registration principles, a mere FIR or unverified complaint is not legal grounds to withhold registration. Only a formal civil court stay or injunction order legally halts the process. Before walking away from a plot or getting trapped in delays, verify whether an actual court order exists on record with OliveTree SafeBuy.
